title: Design: New Work Order shows the No Charge checkbox below Asset Here
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Start on Work Orders.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-02-02a-new-work-order.png, iwo-components-04-new-wo-dialog-v6.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick the regular customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • At the bottom of the window, under a divider below the "Asset Here?" checkbox, an unticked checkbox "No Charge" with an info icon is shown.
  • Hovering the info icon shows the tooltip "Warranty, goodwill or comeback work. Closes without an invoice; parts cost posts to the expense account of the category."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R2: “In the New Work Order dialog (New Work Order only; Edit Work Order, which shares the dialog, is unchanged), picking a customer without the flag shows, at the bottom of the dialog below the "Asset Here?" checkbox and separated from it by a divider, an unticked checkbox "No Charge" with an info icon whose tooltip reads "Warranty, goodwill or comeback work. Closes without an invoice; parts cost posts to the expense account of the category."”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 1 · Create and close" / "Shared screens", boards "02a New work order" (Flow 1 · Create and close), "New WO Dialog v6" (Shared screens).
